search_text: published ZDI-09-099 ZDI-CAN-105 Hewlett-Packard OpenView Data Protector Backup Client Service Buffer Overflow Vulnerability 2009-12-17 CVE-2007-2280 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2007-2280 ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['OpenView Data Protector'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard Storage Data Protector. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the backup client service daemon (OmniInet.exe), which binds to TCP port 5555. During the processing of long arguments to the 'MSG_PROTOCOL' command, a stack based buffer overflow occurs and can result in code execution under the context of the daemon. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
